{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JqMJWE59uwZoWg5nmeTaNx","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * WeeklySchedulePage — the roster reads and writes the scheduling API.\n3\t *\n4\t * HR-HIGH-010: \"Kaydet\" wrote the roster to localStorage and nothing reached\n5\t * the API. These tests pin the replacement: the cells come from the team\n6\t * weekly overview (one query per visible week), a choice in a cell calls the\n7\t * assignment mutation with the employee's plan — or none, so the API creates\n8\t * one — published weeks and leave days take no assignment, publishing goes\n9\t * through the confirm gate, and browser storage is never written.\n10\t */\n11\timport { fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';\n12\timport { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';\n13\timport { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\n14\t\n15\timport type { Shift } from '../../../types/attendance.types';\n16\timport type {\n17\t  DayEntry,\n18\t  EmployeeWeekSummary,\n19\t  TeamWeeklyOverview,\n20\t  WeekDay,\n21\t} from '../../../types/scheduling.types';\n22\timport { WeeklySchedulePage } from '../WeeklySchedulePage';\n23\t\n24\tconst WEEKDAYS: readonly WeekDay[] = [\n25\t  'monday',\n26\t  'tuesday',\n27\t  'wednesday',\n28\t  'thursday',\n29\t  'friday',\n30\t  'saturday',\n31\t  'sunday',\n32\t];\n33\t\n34\ttype DayPattern = 'S' | 'A' | 'off' | 'leave';\n35\t\n36\t/** A day of the week of 2026-09-14, as the overview query returns it. */\n37\tfunction entryOn(weekday: WeekDay, index: number, pattern: DayPattern): DayEntry {\n38\t  const date = `2026-09-${String(14 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n39\t  if (pattern === 'off' || pattern === 'leave') {\n40\t    return { dayOfWeek: weekday, date, entryType: pattern, plannedMinutes: 0 };\n41\t  }\n42\t  return {\n43\t    dayOfWeek: weekday,\n44\t    date,\n45\t    entryType: 'work',\n46\t    shiftCode: pattern,\n47\t    shiftName: pattern === 'S' ? 'Sabah' : 'Akşam',\n48\t    startTime: pattern === 'S' ? '08:00:00' : '16:00:00',\n49\t    endTime: pattern === 'S' ? '16:00:00' : '00:00:00',\n50\t    plannedMinutes: 480,\n51\t  };\n52\t}\n53\t\n54\tfunction week(pattern: readonly DayPattern[]): DayEntry[] {\n55\t  return WEEKDAYS.map((weekday, index) => entryOn(weekday, index, pattern[index] ?? These tests pin the replacement: the cells come from the team\n * weekly overview (one query per visible week), a choice in a cell calls the\n * assignment mutation with the employee's plan — or none, so the API creates\n * one — published weeks and leave days take no assignment, publishing goes\n * through the confirm gate, and browser storage is never written.\n */\nimport { fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\n\nimport type { Shift } from '../../../types/attendance.types';\nimport type {\n  DayEntry,\n  EmployeeWeekSummary,\n  TeamWeeklyOverview,\n  WeekDay,\n} from '../../../types/scheduling.types';\nimport { WeeklySchedulePage } from '../WeeklySchedulePage';\n\nconst WEEKDAYS: readonly WeekDay[] = [\n  'monday',\n  'tuesday',\n  'wednesday',\n  'thursday',\n  'friday',\n  'saturday',\n  'sunday',\n];\n\ntype DayPattern = 'S' | 'A' | 'off' | 'leave';\n\n/** A day of the week of 2026-09-14, as the overview query returns it. */\nfunction entryOn(weekday: WeekDay, index: number, pattern: DayPattern): DayEntry {\n  const date = `2026-09-${String(14 + index).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n  if (pattern === 'off' || pattern === 'leave') {\n    return { dayOfWeek: weekday, date, entryType: pattern, plannedMinutes: 0 };\n  }\n  return {\n    dayOfWeek: weekday,\n    date,\n    entryType: 'work',\n    shiftCode: pattern,\n    shiftName: pattern === 'S' ? 'Sabah' : 'Akşam',\n    startTime: pattern === 'S' ? '08:00:00' : '16:00:00',\n    endTime: pattern === 'S' ? '16:00:00' : '00:00:00',\n    plannedMinutes: 480,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction week(pattern: readonly DayPattern[]): DayEntry[] {\n  return WEEKDAYS.map((weekday, index) => entryOn(weekday, index, pattern[index] ?? 'off'));\n}\n\nfunction overviewFor(weekStartDate: string): TeamWeeklyOverview {\n  const employeePlans: EmployeeWeekSummary[] = [\n    {\n      employeeId: 'e-ayse',\n      employeeName: 'Ayşe Yılmaz',\n      position: 'Teknisyen',\n      weeklyPlanId: 'plan-ayse',\n      planStatus: 'draft',\n      days: week(['S', 'S', 'S', 'S', 'S', 'off', 'off']),\n      totalWorkDays: 5,\n      totalMinutes: 2400,\n      overtimeMinutes: 0,\n    },","numLines":70,"startLine":1,"totalLines":333}}}
